title: Ski Jump Champions
description:
Feel the Rush of Every Jump

Take to the slopes in this retro style 2D ski jumping game. Every jump is a test of timing, technique, and nerve - nail your takeoff, control your posture through the flight, and stick the landing to earn the crowd's roar and to impress the judges for maximum style points.

Game Modes

• Practice - Hone your skills on any hill with no pressure.

• Local Party Mode - Compete locally with up to 60 players, or just a couple of buddies and fill the rest of the field with AI opponents. Perfect for chaotic couch competition.

• Online Cup - Jump on a new hill each day and climb the global leaderboard. Accumulate cup points across a season, with medals and championships on the line.

• Career Mode - Build your skills across multiple seasons. Upgrade your jumper's abilities. Jump power, landing balance and more - as you rise from a newbie to championship glory.
